user.title: Configure your home
user.description: Create a local configuration. No commands will be sent to equipment.

init.title: System configuration
init.description: Add floors and zones, then rooms, manifolds, circuits and sensors. Completed steps are stored as a local draft; reopening this menu resumes it. Select Save configuration to apply changes.

menu_options.import_structure: Import Home Assistant floors and areas

outdoor.title: Outdoor temperature
outdoor.description: Select the outdoor sensor. Leave blank to remove the association, then save the configuration.

telemetry_rooms.title: Room sensors
telemetry_rooms.description: Choose an object, role and entity. Leave the entity blank to remove the role binding.

telemetry_sources.title: Heat source sensors
telemetry_sources.description: Choose an object, role and entity. Leave the entity blank to remove the role binding.

telemetry_manifolds.title: Manifold sensors
telemetry_manifolds.description: Choose an object, role and entity. Leave the entity blank to remove the role binding.

source_properties.title: Fluid properties and costs
source_properties.description: Enter density and specific heat together from the fluid data at the relevant temperature. Empty optional fields remove values. Confirm only compatible measurement boundaries; this does not confirm actual operating mode. The tariff estimates cost of observed consumption.

mode_mapping.title: Map reported source states
mode_mapping.description: Choose a sensor that reports actual operation, not just the selected mode. Enter exact raw state values. Leave unsupported states blank. Remove the sensor to disable this feature.

edit_item.title: Edit object
edit_item.description: Changes apply only after Save configuration. IDs and recorded observations are retained. Temperature history comparisons restart under the changed configuration; use the same physical circuit when correcting its position. Empty optional numeric fields remove their values.

remove_item.title: Confirm removal
remove_item.description: This removes only the configuration object and its own telemetry associations. Dependent objects must be removed separately. Stored history is not explicitly erased; normal retention still applies. Changes apply only after Save configuration.

floor_existing.title: Select existing floor
floor_existing.description: Reuses a uniquely matching existing irPaT floor by name, keeping its ID. No Home Assistant registry changes.

room_existing.title: Select existing area
room_existing.description: Uses the native floor when assigned. An unassigned area needs a local fallback floor. A unique matching local room is reused. Empty properties preserve existing values. Confirm only actual ambient sensors on the next screen.

import_structure.title: Import Home Assistant floors and areas
import_structure.description: Found {floors} floors and {rooms} areas ({unassigned} without a valid floor). Import all assigned areas and floors. Unassigned areas are skipped unless you choose a previously added local floor below. Unique same-name local objects are linked; existing IDs, targets and bindings are preserved. Nothing is written to HA registries. Review sensors separately, then Save configuration.

data.confirmed: Confirm import and matching existing local objects

confirm_sensors.title: Confirm suggested room sensors
confirm_sensors.description: {count} unused candidates assigned to this area or its devices. Select only actual ambient temperature readings (not water/floor probes), or thermostats reporting current temperature. Do not select duplicate measurements of the same probe. Select at most one humidity sensor. Empty selection adds nothing; existing bindings are not replaced.

discard_draft.title: Discard configuration draft
discard_draft.description: Only unapplied edits are discarded. Saved configuration and history are retained.

electric_scenario.title: Electric heating scenario
electric_scenario.description: Set the electricity tariff in Source properties. Enter a reviewed heating COP (or electric heater efficiency as a ratio) for the scenario. Not an automatically measured COP. Leave blank to remove the scenario.

data.cop: Reviewed COP / useful heat to electricity ratio

fuel_properties.title: Fuel billing and conversion
fuel_properties.description: Use the same HHV/LHV basis for all conversions and efficiency. kWh and MWh factors are automatic; other units require verified kWh per unit. Meter must be cumulative with the selected unit. Auxiliary electricity uses the separate source electricity tariff. Empty auxiliary value means unknown, not zero. Current tariff estimates are not invoices.

hybrid_policy.title: Declared operating strategy
hybrid_policy.description: For documentation and advisory analysis only. The outdoor threshold is your existing declared setpoint, not a command or automatically determined economic switching temperature. Actual mode is read separately.

error.invalid_fluid_properties: Provide both valid properties for a known fluid.
error.invalid_mode_mapping: Provide at least one valid, distinct raw state value.
error.unsupported_edit: This structural change requires a new object.
error.object_in_use: Other configuration objects depend on this object. Remove dependencies first.
error.registry_conflict: Ambiguous local match. Rename the conflicting local objects before importing.
error.registry_floor_required: This area has no assigned floor. Add a local floor first or choose a fallback.
error.invalid_fuel_factor: Provide a consistent verified energy conversion factor for this unit.
error.invalid_fuel_basis: Choose a valid energy basis for the fuel.

abort.draft_conflict: Configuration or draft changed in another session. Reopen Configure to continue from the latest checkpoint.
abort.draft_read_failed: Could not read configuration draft. Check Home Assistant logs before retrying.
abort.draft_write_failed: Could not save the latest draft step. Previous saved checkpoints remain; check logs.
